description: Environment setup and green baseline. The system default python is 3.9 but the project requires 3.12; establish a working Python 3.12 venv, install dev deps, and confirm the existing test suite, ruff, and mypy pass before any code changes.
steps: Create a virtualenv with Python 3.12: `python3.12 -m venv .venv` (python3.12 resolves to Python 3.12.14 via /root/.pyenv/shims). Do NOT use bare `python3`/`pytest`/`ruff` which resolve to 3.9 and cannot run this project.
Install dev extras: `.venv/bin/pip install -e '.[dev]'` (installs pytest, pytest-asyncio, pytest-cov, mypy, ruff, pyyaml, python-dotenv). Network is OPEN_INTERNET so this works.
Run the full test suite: `.venv/bin/pytest -q` and record the pass/fail count as the baseline.
Run `.venv/bin/ruff check .` and `.venv/bin/mypy flow deployment` and record baseline status.
Record the exact venv path and commands in the feature findings so later features reuse them.
acceptance_criteria: A `.venv` built with Python 3.12 exists and `.venv/bin/pytest -q` runs the suite.
The existing test suite passes (baseline green) — record the test count.
ruff check reports zero warnings on the unmodified tree (or the exact pre-existing warnings are recorded).
findings note the venv path and the working test/lint/type commands.

Treat the other 1077 passing as the green baseline; later features must keep those green and this same single failure is acceptable/expected under root.
